title: What to Expect From Trump’s New Trade Drama

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After months of delaying his most extreme tariffs, President Trump is now threatening to revive the most aggressive version of his global trade war.
sentences.zh: 在推迟了数月最极端的关税政策后，特朗普总统现在威胁要重启其全球贸易战中最激进的版本。

sentences.en: Now, America's trading partners, investors and consumers are bracing for impact.
sentences.zh: 现在，美国的贸易伙伴、投资者和消费者都在严阵以待。

sentences.en: Today, I speak with three of my colleagues, Anna Swanson, Maggie Haberman and Ben Castleman, about what we can expect and what Trump's endgame might be.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与我的三位同事安娜·斯旺森、玛吉·哈伯曼和本·卡斯尔曼探讨了我们可能面临的情况，以及特朗普的最终目标可能是什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月10日，星期四。

sentences.en: Welcome to the Roundtable Economic Edition.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到圆桌经济版。

sentences.en: Anna, nice to have you.
sentences.zh: 安娜，很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: Ben, thank you for being here in the studio.
sentences.zh: 本，谢谢你来到演播室。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来。

sentences.en: Maggie, it is always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，总是很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Natalie, it is so nice having you here, even if I'm not actually with you.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，很高兴能在这里见到你，即使我实际上并不和你在一起。

sentences.en: We wish you were here.
sentences.zh: 我们真希望你也能在这里。

sentences.en: I want to just set the table for us a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我想先为我们梳理一下背景。

sentences.en: Ninety or so days ago, Trump instigates a global trade war on a scale that the world has never really seen before.
sentences.zh: 大约90天前，特朗普发起了一场全球贸易战，其规模是世界从未见过的。

sentences.en: Reciprocal tariffs on a bunch of countries.
sentences.zh: 对多个国家实施对等关税。

sentences.en: It's this seismic economic event.
sentences.zh: 这是一场地震级的经济事件。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: stock market plunged.
sentences.zh: 股市暴跌。

sentences.en: Trillions of dollars in value are wiped out in a matter of days.
sentences.zh: 数万亿美元的价值在几天内蒸发。

sentences.en: I honestly can't remember an economic event like this.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不记得发生过这样的经济事件。

sentences.en: And then because of all that fallout and the outcry, Trump presses pause on a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 然后，由于所有的连锁反应和抗议，特朗普暂停了其中的大部分措施。

sentences.en: The stock market recovers.
sentences.zh: 股市回升了。

sentences.en: And then everyone gets kind of used to the idea that the trade war is on what seems like a hiatus.
sentences.zh: 于是大家开始习惯于贸易战似乎已经暂停的想法。

sentences.en: Now, it feels like, to the degree that it was ever suspended, the trade war is back.
sentences.zh: 现在，感觉贸易战又回来了，如果说它曾经真正暂停过的话。

sentences.en: He's lobbying these new threats against countries again on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 周三，他再次对各国发出了新的威胁。

sentences.en: So, Ana, can you just lay out for me the current state of play?
sentences.zh: 那么，安娜，你能为我梳理一下目前的局势吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, actually, this trade war was paused, but it never truly went away.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这场贸易战虽然暂停过，但从未真正消失。

sentences.en: The president had paused his tariffs for 90 days in April to try to encourage other countries to come to the United States and do trade deals instead of getting hit with tariffs.
sentences.zh: 总统在四月份暂停了90天的关税，试图鼓励其他国家来美国进行贸易谈判，而不是直接被征收关税。

sentences.en: And in the last three months, we've seen this flurry of activity with other countries trying to get some time on the schedule of U.S.
sentences.zh: 在过去的三个月里，我们看到各国为了争取美国官员的日程安排来谈判这些协议，

sentences.en: officials to negotiate these deals.
sentences.zh: 出现了一阵忙碌。

sentences.en: But in the meantime, the president did actually go ahead with other tariffs on cars and steel, copper, pharmaceuticals.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，总统实际上还是对汽车、钢铁、铜和药品等产品实施了其他关税。

sentences.en: So, even though, you know, the biggest global tariffs have been paused, tariffs have been steadily rising.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然你知道，最大的全球关税已经暂停，但关税一直在稳步上升。

sentences.en: And right now, the overall average effective tariff rate for the United States has climbed up to 17.6 percent,
sentences.zh: 目前，美国的总体平均有效关税税率已经攀升至17.6%，

sentences.en: which is actually the highest that the United States has had since 1934.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是美国自1934年以来的最高水平。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, it might have felt paused, but it's actually kind of on in a way that does not feel insignificant.
sentences.zh: 所以，它可能感觉像是暂停了，但实际上它以一种不容忽视的方式在继续。

sentences.en: It's real.
sentences.zh: 它是真实的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It is on.
sentences.zh: 它正在进行中。

sentences.en: Of course, they're overshadowed by what the president is threatening to put in place just in a matter of a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些都被总统威胁要在几周内实施的措施所掩盖了。

sentences.en: He's now moved his deadline for countries to negotiate deals or face tariffs to August 1St.
sentences.zh: 他现在将各国谈判协议或面临关税的最后期限移到了8月1日。

sentences.en: A lot of countries are working toward these trade deals, and we've seen two of them announced so far, pretty limited deals.
sentences.zh: 许多国家正在努力达成这些贸易协议，到目前为止我们已经看到两项宣布，但协议内容相当有限。

sentences.en: But for many, many more, the president is sending out these letters that are going out globally this week,
sentences.zh: 但对于更多国家来说，总统本周正在向全球发出这些信函，

sentences.en: informing countries of the high tariffs that their products will be charged as of August 1St.
sentences.zh: 通知各国从8月1日起，他们的产品将被征收高额关税。

sentences.en: I just want to quickly ask about the deals that have come.
sentences.zh: 我想快速问一下关于已经达成的协议。

sentences.en: Ana, can you just tell me what are those?
sentences.zh: 安娜，你能告诉我那是什么吗？

sentences.en: How should we be thinking about them?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何看待它们？

sentences.en: So, one that the president announced with the United Kingdom in May is really what I would call kind of a framework deal.
sentences.zh: 总统五月份与英国宣布的一项协议，我称之为框架协议。

sentences.en: So, the two sides agreed to lower tariffs on some certain products.
sentences.zh: 双方同意降低某些产品的关税。

sentences.en: And then for a bunch of other things, they basically said, we're interested in cooperating.
sentences.zh: 而对于其他许多事情，他们基本上说，我们有兴趣合作。

sentences.en: Let's keep talking.
sentences.zh: 让我们继续谈。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: The other big announcement that we've seen was with Vietnam last week.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的另一个重大公告是上周与越南达成的。

sentences.en: The president said on his social media that he had reached an agreement with Vietnam to lower tariffs on some of their products to 20 percent with a higher tariff on some products that would come from China and that Vietnam would open their markets to U.S.
sentences.zh: 总统在社交媒体上表示，他已与越南达成协议，将他们部分产品的关税降至20%，同时对部分来自中国的产品征收更高关税，并且越南将向美国开放市场。

sentences.en: products.
sentences.zh: 产品。

sentences.en: However, nobody has since released any text of the deal or even any fact sheets spelling out what was agreed to with Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 然而，此后没有人发布任何协议文本，甚至没有任何说明与越南达成一致的事实清单。

sentences.en: So, we really don't know at this point if there is a deal, what it actually includes.
sentences.zh: 所以，目前我们真的不知道是否有协议，以及它到底包含了什么。

sentences.en: The only thing we have is the president saying on his social media account.
sentences.zh: 我们唯一拥有的就是总统在社交媒体账户上所说的话。

sentences.en: So, not a ton of clarity.
sentences.zh: 所以，并没有太多的明确性。

sentences.en: It's not a lot of clarity.
sentences.zh: 确实没有多少明确性。

sentences.en: It's not a lot of substance for 90 days.
sentences.zh: 90天过去了，并没有多少实质内容。

sentences.en: But again, I also don't think that's particularly surprising because doing trade deals is hard and it takes a long time.
sentences.zh: 但同样，我认为这并不特别令人惊讶，因为达成贸易协议很难，而且需要很长时间。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, the administration and the world is kind of starting to see that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，政府和世界开始意识到这一点了。

sentences.en: — Maggie, it's interesting he keeps pushing this deadline back.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，他不断推迟最后期限，这很有趣。

sentences.en: What's going on here?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: What's he up to?
sentences.zh: 他在搞什么名堂？

sentences.en: — Well, President Trump has a history of moving deadlines, as we know, both in terms of his life as a real estate developer and also from his first term in office.
sentences.zh: 嗯，众所周知，特朗普总统有推迟最后期限的历史，无论是在他作为房地产开发商的生活中，还是在他第一个任期内。

sentences.en: He tends to buy himself more time to jump from one lily pad to the next, and that's really what this is.
sentences.zh: 他倾向于为自己争取更多时间，从一片荷叶跳到另一片荷叶，这正是现在的情况。

sentences.en: If you look at everything with Donald Trump as an ongoing negotiation, then this makes sense and follows a logical pattern.
sentences.zh: 如果你把唐纳德·特朗普所做的一切都看作是一场持续的谈判，那么这就说得通了，也遵循了逻辑模式。

sentences.en: The problem is that countries engaged in trade can't really function that way.
sentences.zh: 问题是，从事贸易的国家无法以这种方式运作。

sentences.en: And so what's going on here is he is buying himself more time to come up with something that he can call a win, whether that is, you know, a bunch of frameworks for trade deals,
sentences.zh: 所以现在发生的是，他正在为自己争取更多时间来提出一些他可以称之为胜利的东西，无论是贸易协议的框架，

sentences.en: or he is trying to see whether there is some other kind of a mitigating factor he could get in terms of an announcement about a company moving production to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 还是他试图看看是否能获得某种缓解因素，比如关于某家公司将生产转移到美国之类的公告，

sentences.en: and so forth.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: But it's a pretty broad range, Natalie, of what he would consider a win.
sentences.zh: 但娜塔莉，他认为什么是胜利，范围非常广泛。

sentences.en: It's too early to say that this isn't working, you know, but it certainly is not the success that Trump believed it would be.
sentences.zh: 现在说这行不通还为时过早，但它肯定不是特朗普所认为的那种成功。

sentences.en: — I'm interested, Ben, in whether it surprises you that there have been so few deals up until this point.
sentences.zh: 本，我很好奇，到目前为止达成的协议如此之少，这让你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I understand that it sounds like the threat has not worked, but, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我明白这听起来像是威胁没有奏效，但是，你知道，

sentences.en: there were a lot of countries on this list that were going to get hit by tariffs on Liberation Day, as he called it.
sentences.zh: 名单上有许多国家将在他所谓的“解放日”受到关税打击。

sentences.en: Why didn't they come to the table?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么不坐到谈判桌前？

sentences.en: I mean, what's going on there?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那里发生了什么？

sentences.en: — Yeah, I mean, I think on one level it's not surprising, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为在某种程度上这并不令人惊讶，对吧？

sentences.en: The idea of 90 deals in 90 days was never plausible, right?
sentences.zh: 90天内达成90项协议的想法从来就不可行，对吧？

sentences.en: Trade deals take years to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 贸易协议需要数年时间来谈判。

sentences.en: But I think that for a lot of these countries, you know, one, their leaders have their own domestic concerns.
sentences.zh: 但我认为对于许多这些国家来说，第一，他们的领导人有自己的国内顾虑。

sentences.en: They don't want to be seen as caving to Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们不想被视为向特朗普屈服。

sentences.en: And look, you know, Maggie made the point a moment ago about, you know, Trump having a history of pushing out deadlines and backing down on some things.
sentences.zh: 而且你看，玛吉刚才提到了特朗普有推迟最后期限和在某些事情上退缩的历史。

sentences.en: I think that has been noticed by foreign leaders.
sentences.zh: 我想这一点已经被外国领导人注意到了。

sentences.en: And there's a recognition that, you know, hey, if we, you know, string this out for a while, like, maybe we can, you know, get out of some of this.
sentences.zh: 人们认识到，嘿，如果我们把这件事拖上一段时间，也许我们能摆脱其中的一些麻烦。

sentences.en: Maybe some of this doesn't actually end up hitting us as hard, at least, as being threatened.
sentences.zh: 也许其中一些最终不会像威胁的那样严重地打击我们。

sentences.en: I think that is definitely true that countries have realized that they can kind of, you know, have some elastic approach here in terms of what Trump will tolerate.
sentences.zh: 我认为各国已经意识到他们可以在特朗普能容忍的范围内采取某种灵活的方法，这绝对是真的。

sentences.en: But there's a point that an economic expert made to me about how Trump seems to view these tariff impositions as he keeps describing them, which is I set the level.
sentences.zh: 但一位经济专家向我指出，特朗普似乎以他不断描述的方式看待这些关税征收，即我设定水平。

sentences.en: You do what I want.
sentences.zh: 你做我想要的。

sentences.en: You give up the terms that I want.
sentences.zh: 你放弃我想要的条款。

sentences.en: And otherwise, you're going to be punished.
sentences.zh: 否则，你就会受到惩罚。

sentences.en: But some of these countries have seen that he doesn't necessarily abide by the deal frameworks he says he's going to anyway.
sentences.zh: 但其中一些国家已经看到，他并不一定遵守他所说的协议框架。

sentences.en: So they don't have a ton of incentives to come forward and make concessions because who knows what happens after that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们没有太大的动力站出来做出让步，因为谁知道那之后会发生什么。

sentences.en: I just want to step back and think for a moment here about, like, what the point of all of this is for the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 我想退后一步，思考一下特朗普政府做这一切的目的是什么。

sentences.en: There are two big kind of ideas behind all of this, as far as I understand it.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这一切背后有两个大想法。

sentences.en: Get manufacturing back to the United States and raise money through these additional tariffs.
sentences.zh: 让制造业回到美国，并通过这些额外关税筹集资金。

sentences.en: Where are we, Ben, on those fronts, on the impacts of all of this so far?
sentences.zh: 本，在这些方面，到目前为止所有这些的影响如何？

sentences.en: And I want to first start with the easier of these two, the raising money part.
sentences.zh: 我想先从这两个中较容易的一个开始，即筹集资金的部分。

sentences.en: How much money has been raised?
sentences.zh: 筹集了多少钱？

sentences.en: How big of a deal is it?
sentences.zh: 这有多重要？

sentences.en: We're bringing in tariff revenue at record-setting rates.
sentences.zh: 我们正以创纪录的速度获得关税收入。

sentences.en: You know, Scott Bassett, the Treasury Secretary, referred to having collected about $100 billion in tariff revenue.
sentences.zh: 你知道，财政部长斯科特·巴塞特提到已经征收了大约1000亿美元的关税收入。

sentences.en: That's a little misleading because we already collected tariff revenue, right?
sentences.zh: 这有点误导，因为我们本来就已经在征收关税了，对吧？

sentences.en: So it's about $50 billion of additional tariff revenue.
sentences.zh: 所以这大约是500亿美元的额外关税收入。

sentences.en: But that's real money.
sentences.zh: 但这可是实实在在的钱。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But it's important to remember who's paying that, right?
sentences.zh: 但记住是谁在支付这些钱很重要，对吧？

sentences.en: That's being paid by importers, right?
sentences.zh: 这是由进口商支付的，对吧？

sentences.en: Which means American companies.
sentences.zh: 这意味着美国公司。

sentences.en: And one way or another, that's going to end up passing through into the American economy, whether that's through the companies paying it and losing it in their profit margins
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，这最终会传导到美国经济中，无论是通过公司支付并损失利润空间，

sentences.en: or ultimately it getting passed on to consumers.
sentences.zh: 还是最终转嫁给消费者。

sentences.en: So, yes, it's revenue for the federal government, but it's revenue that you and I in some form or fashion are ultimately paying.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是联邦政府的收入，但这是你和我以某种形式最终支付的收入。

sentences.en: But is that true?
sentences.zh: 但这是真的吗？

sentences.en: Because I'm wondering if we've actually seen the price increases that we were warned about.
sentences.zh: 因为我想知道我们是否真的看到了我们被警告的价格上涨。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, so I think it's funny, right, because the president is saying, oh, you know, tariffs are going to bring back manufacturing jobs.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这很有趣，因为总统说，哦，你知道，关税会带回制造业工作岗位。

sentences.en: So far, we've been losing manufacturing jobs.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们一直在失去制造业工作岗位。

sentences.en: Critics are saying, oh, tariffs are going to raise prices and slow down the economy.
sentences.zh: 批评者说，哦，关税会提高价格并减缓经济增长。

sentences.en: So far, prices have continued to moderate and the economy has remained relatively solid, right?
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，价格持续温和，经济保持相对稳固，对吧？

sentences.en: So on some level, it's sort of defying all the narratives and the economy is kind of trucking along.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，它有点违背了所有的叙述，经济正在稳步前进。

sentences.en: Wait, can you just pause on that for a second?
sentences.zh: 等等，你能暂停一下吗？

sentences.en: Are you saying the prices haven't gone up?
sentences.zh: 你是说价格没有上涨吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so it's complicated.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这很复杂。

sentences.en: Overall inflation has continued to cool, right?
sentences.zh: 总体通胀持续降温，对吧？

sentences.en: So we have not seen this sort of big jump in consumer prices.
sentences.zh: 所以我们没有看到消费者价格出现这种大幅跳升。

sentences.en: If you zoom in and if you look at products that we're importing from China, for example, you do see some evidence that some of that is picking up, but not in a sort of a crazy way.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细观察，比如我们从中国进口的产品，你确实看到了一些证据表明价格正在上涨，但并不是以一种疯狂的方式。

sentences.en: And even though, as Anna said, we have seen higher tariffs than we've seen historically, it's not at this sort of wild level that was being threatened back in April.
sentences.zh: 而且尽管正如安娜所说，我们看到的关税比历史上要高，但并没有达到四月份威胁的那种疯狂水平。

sentences.en: And so instead, what we see is this sort of gradual impact, gradual erosion that's going to take time to play out in the economy.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们看到的是这种逐渐的影响，这种在经济中需要时间才能显现的逐渐侵蚀。

sentences.en: But for now, at least, even with this kind of historically high effective tariff rate, we're not seeing prices go up yet is what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 但至少目前，即使有这种历史上高位的有效关税税率，我们还没有看到价格上涨，你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那意味着什么？

sentences.en: Like, what's going on there?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Does that mean companies are largely eating the cost of the tariffs, the $100 billion?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着公司在很大程度上承担了1000亿美元的关税成本？

sentences.en: Because that surprises me.
sentences.zh: 因为这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I think it has surprised a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我认为这让很多人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: But maybe it shouldn't have, right?
sentences.zh: 但也许不应该感到惊讶，对吧？

sentences.en: It's going to take time, even in the best of circumstances, for companies to sort of figure out how they're going to make their pricing decisions, right?
sentences.zh: 即使在最好的情况下，公司也需要时间来弄清楚他们将如何做出定价决策，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not like tariff hits and you immediately pass on that price, right?
sentences.zh: 并不是说关税一实施，你就会立即转嫁价格，对吧？

sentences.en: That's something that takes time.
sentences.zh: 那是需要时间的。

sentences.en: And companies, because they saw this coming, rushed to buy products, to import products.
sentences.zh: 而且公司因为预见到了这一点，抢购产品，进口产品。

sentences.en: We saw a huge surge of imports in the first months of this year as companies rushed to bring things in before the tariffs hit.
sentences.zh: 我们看到今年头几个月进口量激增，因为公司赶在关税生效前把东西运进来。

sentences.en: What that means is they've got a whole bunch of inventory that's sitting there that they didn't have to pay the high tariffs on.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们手里有一大批库存，而这些库存并不需要缴纳高额关税。

sentences.en: And that gives them a little bit of wiggle room to make some decisions about how they're going to pass on these prices or not.
sentences.zh: 这给了他们一定的回旋余地，来决定是否要将这些成本转嫁出去。

sentences.en: And then you have this uncertainty element.
sentences.zh: 然后就是这种不确定性因素。

sentences.en: You've got all of these companies that are sitting here saying, I don't know what the – as Anna was saying, I don't know what the tariff is going to be.
sentences.zh: 你看看这些公司，他们都在说，正如安娜所说，我不知道关税到底会是多少。

sentences.en: I don't know what my material costs are going to be.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我的材料成本会是多少。

sentences.en: And so I think that there's a reluctance to make big decisions.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，大家在做重大决策时会有所顾虑。

sentences.en: There's a lot of sort of putting it on hold.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，很多事情都被搁置了。

sentences.en: And that's true on the price level.
sentences.zh: 在价格层面是这样。

sentences.en: But it's also true on hiring, on investing.
sentences.zh: 在招聘和投资方面也是如此。

sentences.en: There's just kind of a pause in a lot of parts of the economy right now.
sentences.zh: 目前经济的许多领域都处于一种停滞状态。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there's the fact that when this first happened, you had some big companies start to say, we're going to raise prices.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有个事实是，当这件事刚发生时，一些大公司开始说，我们要涨价了。

sentences.en: I'm thinking of Walmart.
sentences.zh: 我想到的是沃尔玛。

sentences.en: And Trump comes out and really hammers them.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普出来，狠狠地抨击了他们。

sentences.en: Maggie, I'm wondering if you think there's any chance that, in addition to what Ben is saying,
sentences.zh: 玛吉，我想知道你是否认为，除了本所说的之外，

sentences.en: that there's a part of this where companies are seeing that and eating the cost because they just don't want to piss Trump off.
sentences.zh: 是否还有一部分原因是公司看到了这一点，选择自己承担成本，因为他们不想惹恼特朗普。

sentences.en: I think that's 100 percent a reality here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这百分之百是现实情况。

sentences.en: And I think that is where you see tariffs as a weapon that he uses domestically, not just with countries overseas or companies that might be based elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这就是你所看到的关税——他将其作为一种在国内使用的武器，而不仅仅是针对海外国家或设在其他地方的公司。

sentences.en: He has shown that he is willing, Natalie, not just to publicly name and shame, which is part of what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，他已经表明他不仅愿意公开点名羞辱——这正是你所谈论的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, we certainly saw him do it, say, with Jeff Bezos when some element of Amazon was listing what the impact of the tariffs would be on certain products.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们当然看到他这样做过，比如当亚马逊的某些部门列出关税对特定产品的影响时，他针对杰夫·贝佐斯。

sentences.en: It wasn't across the website, but there was some aspect of it.
sentences.zh: 那并不是针对整个网站，但确实涉及了某些方面。

sentences.en: And that was undone in like an hour.
sentences.zh: 结果不到一小时就撤回了。

sentences.en: Anna, I want to turn now to bringing manufacturing back to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 安娜，我想转而谈谈制造业回流美国的问题。

sentences.en: That was the stated goal of these tariffs, right?
sentences.zh: 那是这些关税的既定目标，对吧？

sentences.en: And obviously, manufacturing wasn't going to come back in three months.
sentences.zh: 显然，制造业不可能在三个月内就回流。

sentences.en: But do we see any signs that companies are moving in that direction, that they're at least trying to move some of their operations back to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我们是否看到任何迹象表明公司正在朝着那个方向努力，即他们至少在尝试将部分业务迁回美国，

sentences.en: as a result of all the tariff pressure they're seeing?
sentences.zh: 作为他们所面临的所有关税压力的结果？

sentences.en: So in the data so far, it seems like, no, we're not seeing, you know, evidence that, for example, company spending on new factories is increasing.
sentences.zh: 从目前的数据来看，似乎并没有，你知道，我们没有看到证据表明，例如，公司在新工厂上的支出在增加。

sentences.en: It looks like company spending on new manufacturing facilities has kind of trended downward in the last few months since Trump came into office.
sentences.zh: 看起来自特朗普上任以来的几个月里，公司在新制造设施上的支出呈下降趋势。

sentences.en: We've also seen a loss in manufacturing jobs in recent months.
sentences.zh: 我们最近几个月也看到了制造业就业岗位的流失。

sentences.en: So the overall jobs numbers for the United States have been strong, but that's actually been buoyed a lot by health care and, you know, certain sectors.
sentences.zh: 所以美国整体的就业数据一直很强劲，但这很大程度上是由医疗保健和某些特定行业支撑的。

sentences.en: Actually, factories are losing thousands of workers in the last few months.
sentences.zh: 事实上，工厂在过去几个月里流失了数千名工人。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think to piggyback on what Anna was saying there,
sentences.zh: 是的，我想顺着安娜刚才说的话补充一点，

sentences.en: the way that these tariffs have been rolled out have really sort of undermined some of the president's stated goals on this.
sentences.zh: 这些关税的实施方式实际上在某种程度上破坏了总统在这方面的一些既定目标。

sentences.en: And I hear that when I talk to economists, but also when I talk to businesses.
sentences.zh: 我和经济学家交谈时听到了这种说法，和企业交谈时也是如此。

sentences.en: So if you're a business right now, if you're a manufacturer thinking like, hey, maybe I should step up my manufacturing in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你现在是一家企业，如果你是一家制造商，心想，嘿，也许我应该加大在美国的制造力度，

sentences.en: you really don't have the information you need to make that bet.
sentences.zh: 你真的没有足够的信息来下这个赌注。

sentences.en: You don't, you know, you say, oh, well, I'm going to enjoy some protection here from these tariffs, and then they get removed a month later or they never take effect.
sentences.zh: 你没有，你知道，你说，哦，好吧，我在这里会享受到这些关税带来的保护，结果一个月后它们就被取消了，或者它们从未生效。

sentences.en: And so I think that even to the extent that these policies might sort of theoretically work, this set of policies, as they've actually been implemented,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，即使这些政策在理论上可能行得通，但这一套政策，就其实际执行情况而言，

sentences.en: is not likely to yield that result.
sentences.zh: 不太可能产生预期的结果。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a great point.
sentences.zh: 是的，说得太好了。

sentences.en: And, I mean, moving supply chains takes, you know, many months, can take years and billions of dollars, right?
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，转移供应链需要，你知道，好几个月，甚至可能需要几年时间和数十亿美元，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So these are long-term investments, and the president has been moving in contrast on kind of a daily or hourly timeline in terms of shifting the strategy.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是长期投资，而总统在战略调整方面，却是在以一种日甚至小时为单位的时间线上反复无常。

sentences.en: He's also been working from a framework as if it is still 1990-something.
sentences.zh: 他所依据的框架也仿佛还停留在1990年代。

sentences.en: You know, we are in a very different economy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们现在处于一个非常不同的经济环境中。

sentences.en: A lot of what he is looking to restore is going to be, it's not just that it takes time, it's that it's so impractical for some of these companies.
sentences.zh: 他想要恢复的很多东西，不仅仅是需要时间的问题，而是对其中一些公司来说太不切实际了。

sentences.en: You can take Apple as an example.
sentences.zh: 你可以以苹果公司为例。

sentences.en: To Ben's point, I'm not sure how much of this is going to materialize the way he believes it will, and I certainly know Tim Cook made that clear to him.
sentences.zh: 正如本所言，我不确定这其中有多少会像他预期的那样实现，而且我肯定蒂姆·库克已经向他明确表达了这一点。

sentences.en: I feel like what all three of you are sort of saying is that we are just in really early days here.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们三位所说的，就是我们现在还处于非常早期的阶段。

sentences.en: We don't quite have a verdict on this, and maybe it's sort of misguided to even be measuring this by short-term gains.
sentences.zh: 我们对此还没有定论，也许用短期收益来衡量这一切本身就是误导。

sentences.en: Yeah, why are we doing this episode at all, Natalie?
sentences.zh: 是的，娜塔莉，我们为什么要录这一集呢？

sentences.en: I think what we can say with confidence right now is, one, there are costs to these policies that are ultimately going to be borne by the American people in one form or another.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们现在可以肯定地说，第一，这些政策是有代价的，最终将以某种形式由美国人民承担。

sentences.en: And that the benefits, whatever they might be, are not likely to be as clear as they might be if these policies were rolled out in a different way.
sentences.zh: 第二，这些政策带来的好处，无论是什么，都不太可能像以不同方式实施时那样清晰。

sentences.en: We're going to pause for a break because, Ben, not only are we doing this episode, but we're going to do a whole other half of this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们要暂停一下，因为本，我们不仅在录这一集，我们还要录这一集的下半部分。

sentences.en: And when we come back, we're going to talk about some of the bigger potential impacts of all of this tariff drama.
sentences.zh: 等我们回来，我们将讨论所有这些关税闹剧带来的一些更大的潜在影响。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Ben, I have to ask about one of the big fears that has been baked into all of this from the beginning, which is a recession.
sentences.zh: 本，我必须问一下从一开始就贯穿于这一切的一个大担忧，那就是经济衰退。

sentences.en: The idea that companies could pull back on hiring and expanding, that people would lose jobs, the economy would shrink.
sentences.zh: 即公司可能会缩减招聘和扩张，人们会失业，经济会萎缩。

sentences.en: I think that does not seem to have happened.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种情况似乎并没有发生。

sentences.en: We've seen good job numbers month after month.
sentences.zh: 我们每个月都看到了不错的就业数据。

sentences.en: How should we think about the economy right now, Ben?
sentences.zh: 本，我们现在应该如何看待经济？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think that if you, again, go back to that April 2nd period, there were a lot of Wall Street forecasters,
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我想如果你再次回到4月2日那个时期，当时有很多华尔街预测者，

sentences.en: economists who were warning of a real risk of an imminent recession as a result of that.
sentences.zh: 经济学家都在警告，由于那个原因，存在迫在眉睫的经济衰退的真正风险。

sentences.en: But then Trump pulled back.
sentences.zh: 但后来特朗普退缩了。

sentences.en: And so what we're seeing now instead are predictions that rather than that being this one acute thing that looks like a big recession, that it's more kind of a slow drip.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在看到的不是那种看起来像大衰退的急性事件的预测，而更像是一种缓慢的滴漏。

sentences.en: Somebody compared it to a Brexit scenario.
sentences.zh: 有人把它比作英国脱欧的情景。

sentences.en: Britain leaves the European Union.
sentences.zh: 英国离开了欧盟。

sentences.en: And instead of there being sort of some immediate recession, their economy is just weaker for an extended period of time.
sentences.zh: 结果并没有出现某种即时的衰退，而是他们的经济在很长一段时间内都变得疲软。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, the sky didn't fall in the case of Brexit either, you know, like we're not seeing some major meteor hit.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，英国脱欧时天也没有塌下来，你知道，就像我们没有看到什么巨大的陨石撞击一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, but we know from other evidence, right, that Americans are not feeling good about the economy.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我们从其他证据中知道，对吧，美国人对经济感觉并不好。

sentences.en: And we saw a real decline in all measures of consumer confidence early in Trump's term.
sentences.zh: 我们在特朗普任期早期看到了消费者信心各项指标的真正下滑。

sentences.en: What's interesting, right, is we went through the same thing under Biden, right, when voters didn't feel good about the economy,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，对吧，我们在拜登执政期间也经历了同样的事情，对吧，当时选民对经济感觉不好，

sentences.en: but they kept spending money and the economy basically looked OK.
sentences.zh: 但他们一直在花钱，经济基本看起来还行。

sentences.en: And here we are sort of again in the same realm of voters don't feel good, but they're continuing to spend and we don't see that much evidence of economic damage.
sentences.zh: 我们现在又处于同样的境地，选民感觉不好，但他们继续消费，而且我们没有看到太多经济受损的证据。

sentences.en: Maggie, do you get the sense that there's any hesitancy in the White House right now about restarting these tariffs?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，你是否感觉到白宫现在对重启这些关税有任何犹豫？

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: like that pushing for these broader tariffs now might have a negative impact on the economy when you have all of these vulnerabilities potentially with voters around this.
sentences.zh: 就像现在推动这些更广泛的关税可能会对经济产生负面影响，而你周围的选民在这一点上可能存在所有这些脆弱性。

sentences.en: You know, at a moment when they don't feel that good about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在他们对经济感觉不好的时候。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People keep saying to me, Trump's poll numbers are sliding and it's really choose your own adventure.
sentences.zh: 人们一直对我说，特朗普的民调数字在下滑，这真的就像是“选择你自己的冒险”游戏。

sentences.en: His numbers are actually pretty stable.
sentences.zh: 他的数字实际上相当稳定。

sentences.en: They've gone down a little bit, certainly on how the voters view him in terms of the economy.
sentences.zh: 确实下降了一点，当然是在选民如何看待他在经济方面的表现上。

sentences.en: That has changed on that specific question, and that's a warning sign for him.
sentences.zh: 在那个具体问题上确实发生了变化，这对他是一个警告信号。

sentences.en: Where his advisers get concerned is that he has turned talking about tariffs into his entire public-facing economic discussion.
sentences.zh: 他的顾问们担心的是，他已经把谈论关税变成了他整个公开的经济讨论内容。

sentences.en: And that does risk having voters start to get concerned about what it means for them and maybe make that association of, oh, this is why, you know,
sentences.zh: 这确实冒着让选民开始担心这对他们意味着什么的风险，并可能产生这种联想，哦，这就是为什么，你知道，

sentences.en: my paycheck is not going as far as it was.
sentences.zh: 我的工资不如以前经花了。

sentences.en: But Trump has proven remarkably durable at being able to keep saying something that isn't necessarily the case and having his voters believe it.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普已经证明，他非常擅长坚持说一些不一定是事实的话，并让他的选民相信它。

sentences.en: I just want to make sure I'm getting this.
sentences.zh: 我只是想确保我理解了。

sentences.en: Maggie, you're saying his numbers on the economy have changed, like people have kind of soured on him in that respect?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，你是说他在经济方面的数字变了，就像人们在那方面对他感到失望一样？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If you look at the crosstabs, Natalie, on Trump, I'm paraphrasing on what the exact question is because every pollster asks it a little bit differently.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，如果你看特朗普的交叉分析表，我是在转述具体的问题，因为每个民调机构问的方式略有不同。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But how people feel about his handling of the economy, it used to really be his calling card.
sentences.zh: 但人们对他处理经济的方式的感觉，过去确实是他的金字招牌。

sentences.en: It was his strength over Hillary Clinton in 2016.
sentences.zh: 这是他在2016年胜过希拉里·克林顿的优势。

sentences.en: It was certainly his strength over both Joe Biden and then Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 这当然也是他胜过乔·拜登和后来的卡玛拉·哈里斯的优势。

sentences.en: That is now underwater, that specific metric.
sentences.zh: 现在，那个特定的指标已经处于劣势了。

sentences.en: There are warning signs that voters are not happy.
sentences.zh: 有警告信号表明选民并不满意。

sentences.en: It's just not that they are necessarily saying, and therefore, I wish Trump wasn't president or, and therefore, I don't want Republicans to be in power.
sentences.zh: 只是他们不一定在说，因此，我希望特朗普不是总统，或者，因此，我不希望共和党人掌权。

sentences.en: One thing to remember about this president, Natalie, is, I mean, he has, to be fair to him, been saying, you know, that NAFTA was a terrible deal for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，关于这位总统有一件事要记住，我的意思是，公平地说，他一直说，你知道，北美自由贸易协定是一个糟糕的协议，已经说了30年了。

sentences.en: But he didn't discard NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有废除北美自由贸易协定。

sentences.en: He redid a version of it, right?
sentences.zh: 他重做了一个版本，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, like, we're not looking at, like, an entirely wholesale change in trade.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们看到的并不是贸易上的彻底改变。

sentences.en: What you just said, Maggie, is sort of that while Trump talks about kind of reimagining the global system of trade in these kind of big maximalist terms,
sentences.zh: 玛吉，你刚才所说的，某种程度上是说，虽然特朗普谈论的是以这种宏大的、极端的术语来重构全球贸易体系，

sentences.en: at the end of the day, what we've seen in his record is that he does a deal.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们在他的记录中看到的是，他确实达成了协议。

sentences.en: He is making changes, but he's not upending the whole system.
sentences.zh: 他正在做出改变，但他并没有颠覆整个体系。

sentences.en: No, well, he's upending the whole system in the sense that there's a lot of chaos and unpredictability, right?
sentences.zh: 不，好吧，他在某种意义上颠覆了整个体系，因为有很多混乱和不可预测性，对吧？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And people don't feel like they can know what's happening day to day.
sentences.zh: 人们觉得无法预知每天会发生什么。

sentences.en: But inconsistency is not an entirely changed dynamic.
sentences.zh: 但这种不一致性并不是一个完全改变的动态。

sentences.en: And this is not some whole new economy.
sentences.zh: 而且这也不是什么全新的经济。

sentences.en: You know, he is a developer who, yes, he has built some properties like Trump Tower.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是一位开发商，是的，他建造了一些房产，比如特朗普大厦。

sentences.en: But often what he does is he takes over somebody else's partly built property or a property that didn't work and then changes them into a Trump property.
sentences.zh: 但通常他做的是接手别人建了一半的房产，或者一个经营不善的房产，然后把它们变成特朗普的房产。

sentences.en: And there's some aspect of that now, what he is doing.
sentences.zh: 他现在所做的也有这方面的因素。

sentences.en: We've been talking about a situation in which Trump is not building something from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在谈论一种情况，即特朗普并不是从零开始建造东西。

sentences.en: He's not remaking the system out of whole cloth.
sentences.zh: 他并不是凭空重塑体系。

sentences.en: You know, companies are maybe betting on that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，公司可能是在赌这一点。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if China, if the relationship with China is the exception.
sentences.zh: 我想知道中国，与中国的关系是否是个例外。

sentences.en: You know, it's been the stated priority of this trade war for a long time now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这长期以来一直是这场贸易战的既定优先事项。

sentences.en: Ana, is that still the case?
sentences.zh: 安娜，现在还是这样吗？

sentences.en: Does Trump still have his eyes trained on China?
sentences.zh: 特朗普的目光是否仍然盯着中国？

sentences.en: Is he still wanting to go big, at least in his aggression trade-wise with that country?
sentences.zh: 他是否仍然想大干一场，至少在对该国的贸易侵略性方面？

sentences.en: You know, it's true that the subtext of a lot of these global trade negotiations has been about China.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多全球贸易谈判的潜台词确实一直都是关于中国的。

sentences.en: So with Vietnam, part of what the president said had been agreed to is that the Vietnamese will have lower tariffs on products that they send,
sentences.zh: 所以对于越南，总统所说的已达成一致的一部分是，越南人对他们发送的产品将征收较低的关税，

sentences.en: but then higher tariffs on products that have a certain amount of Chinese content in them.
sentences.zh: 但对含有一定比例中国成分的产品征收更高的关税。

sentences.en: But it's really not clear how the United States is going to enforce that.
sentences.zh: 但美国将如何执行这一点确实不清楚。

sentences.en: But we know that's something that they've been discussing with other nations in Asia, Malaysia, for example.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道这是他们一直在与亚洲其他国家讨论的事情，例如马来西亚。

sentences.en: It's something the Trump team has brought up with Europe and Mexico.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普团队与欧洲和墨西哥提出过的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That does seem directed at isolating China, right?
sentences.zh: 这看起来确实是针对孤立中国的，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: No, I mean, there's definitely, you know,
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，绝对有，你知道，

sentences.en: kind of global effort to look at Chinese products that are getting into the United States through other countries and finding these loopholes into the United States.
sentences.zh: 某种全球性的努力，去审视那些通过其他国家进入美国并找到这些漏洞进入美国的中国产品。

sentences.en: So that activity has been going on since the first Trump administration when we had really high tariffs on China.
sentences.zh: 所以这种活动从第一届特朗普政府时期就开始了，当时我们对中国征收了非常高的关税。

sentences.en: And there definitely is part of the negotiations right now that aims to counter that.
sentences.zh: 而且目前的谈判中确实有一部分旨在应对这一点。

sentences.en: I want to turn to the markets here because we saw that after Liberation Day, the first kind of April tariff day,
sentences.zh: 我想转到市场这里，因为我们看到在“解放日”，即第一个“四月关税日”之后，

sentences.en: the markets seem to play a pretty outsized role in moving Trump to scale back, to put those tariffs on pause.
sentences.zh: 市场似乎在促使特朗普缩减规模、暂停这些关税方面发挥了相当大的作用。

sentences.en: Do you think that the market's going to react to this new chapter of the trade war the way that it did last time?
sentences.zh: 你认为市场会对贸易战的这个新篇章做出像上次那样的反应吗？

sentences.en: Do we have any early signs of that?
sentences.zh: 我们有任何早期的迹象吗？

sentences.en: And if not, why?
sentences.zh: 如果没有，为什么？

sentences.en: I mean, so far, they certainly have not.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，到目前为止，他们当然没有。

sentences.en: And it seems that for the most part, investors are betting that this is a bluff again and that there will be further extensions.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来在很大程度上，投资者押注这又是一个虚张声势，并且会有进一步的延期。

sentences.en: Now, that raises the risk that if these actually do take effect and it looks like they're going to stick, that then the markets will react in a much larger way.
sentences.zh: 现在，这增加了风险，如果这些关税真的生效，而且看起来它们会坚持下去，那么市场将会有更大的反应。

sentences.en: There are hints of concerns among bond buyers that, you know, are related not just to tariffs now,
sentences.zh: 债券买家中出现了一些担忧的迹象，你知道，这不仅与现在的关税有关，

sentences.en: but also to this big, beautiful bill and the trillions of dollars that it added to the debt.
sentences.zh: 还与这个“宏大、美妙的法案”以及它增加的数万亿美元债务有关。

sentences.en: I think that's where the concerns are now in the bond market, which could end up having a real impact on Trump and what he's able to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是债券市场目前担忧的地方，这最终可能会对特朗普以及他能做的事情产生真正的影响。

sentences.en: But it's not – we're not seeing the kind of, you know, violent reaction that we saw back in April.
sentences.zh: 但它不是——我们没有看到像四月份那样激烈的反应。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Just stepping back, I want to think about where we are here and the reality that Trump is still in this kind of half-in, half-out trade war.
sentences.zh: 退一步说，我想思考一下我们现在的处境，以及特朗普仍然处于这种半进半出的贸易战中的现实。

sentences.en: I want to talk about how we think about that in the larger context of how Trump uses his power.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈在特朗普如何行使权力的更大背景下，我们该如何看待这一点。

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say that the president has been remarkably successful at exercising his power over all kinds of realms in these first several months of his term
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，总统在任期的最初几个月里，在各个领域行使权力方面都取得了显著的成功，

sentences.en: and basically forcing many people to bend to his will, Congress, universities, law firms, Iran even.
sentences.zh: 基本上迫使许多人屈从于他的意志，包括国会、大学、律师事务所，甚至伊朗。

sentences.en: Why does it seem like these trade deals are exempt from that or like the one thing that seems to be beguiling him?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些贸易协议似乎是个例外，或者说，为什么贸易协议似乎是他唯一无法掌控的事情？

sentences.en: Maggie?
sentences.zh: 玛吉？

sentences.en: Because you can't – threats work to a point with global trade and with global markets, but they have their own sets of concerns and dynamics and behaviors.
sentences.zh: 因为你不能——威胁在全球贸易和全球市场中只能起到一定作用，但它们有自己的一套顾虑、动态和行为模式。

sentences.en: He has levers that he is able to push and pull with, say, universities or law firms that he was threatening with executive orders or even, you know, individuals.
sentences.zh: 他拥有可以用来施压的杠杆，比如针对大学或律师事务所，他曾用行政命令威胁过它们，甚至威胁过个人。

sentences.en: You can't force the markets to bend to your will the same way.
sentences.zh: 你无法用同样的方式强迫市场屈从于你的意志。

sentences.en: You can't force other countries to bend to your will the same way.
sentences.zh: 你无法用同样的方式强迫其他国家屈从于你的意志。

sentences.en: And what ends up happening is because the world is built on alliances, you risk pushing countries toward your adversaries, not closer to you, not just militarily,
sentences.zh: 最终发生的情况是，由于世界是建立在联盟基础上的，你冒着将各国推向你的对手的风险，而不是推向你这边，这不仅仅是在军事上，

sentences.en: not just in terms of defense alliances, but in terms of trade and in terms of all kinds of other dynamics.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是在防御联盟方面，在贸易以及各种其他动态方面也是如此。

sentences.en: And I do think the backing off hurts him.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实认为这种退缩对他不利。

sentences.en: I mean, I think on some fundamental level, right, Trump has been able to rewrite the political rulebook in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为在某种根本层面上，特朗普确实能够改写美国的政治规则手册。

sentences.en: He's been able to write the legal rulebook to some degree in the U.S., thanks to both Congress and the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 多亏了国会和最高法院，他在一定程度上也能够改写美国的法律规则手册。

sentences.en: He can't rewrite the rules of economics.
sentences.zh: 但他无法改写经济规律。

sentences.en: And there's this fundamental level that, you know, he could go and impose these steep tariffs on China, on the European Union, all of these countries.
sentences.zh: 在根本层面上，你知道，他可以去对中国、欧盟以及所有这些国家征收高额关税。

sentences.en: He apparently has the power to do that.
sentences.zh: 他显然有权这样做。

sentences.en: But he can't control what happens as a result of that.
sentences.zh: 但他无法控制由此产生的结果。

sentences.en: And I think if you're a company right now, you do not have the confidence that whatever gets put in place is going to be the long-run reality.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果你现在是一家公司，你不会相信目前实施的任何政策都会成为长期的现实。

sentences.en: And so there's going to be a lot of hedging of bets.
sentences.zh: 所以，大家会进行大量的风险对冲。

sentences.en: There's going to be a lot of spreading around of supply chains and probably some inefficiencies that result from that.
sentences.zh: 供应链会进行大量的分散，这可能会导致一些效率低下。

sentences.en: Anna?
sentences.zh: 安娜？

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I agree with Ben.
sentences.zh: 是的，不，我同意本的观点。

sentences.en: Ben, I think the economy is a really big and complicated place.
sentences.zh: 本，我认为经济是一个非常庞大且复杂的地方。

sentences.en: So we don't, you know, immediately see some of the effects of these tariffs, but they are there and they are real.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不会立即看到这些关税带来的一些影响，但它们确实存在，而且是真实的。

sentences.en: It's, you know, hundreds of billions of dollars that the United States is collecting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是美国正在征收的数千亿美元。

sentences.en: And that has real implications for trade and for companies.
sentences.zh: 这对贸易和公司有着真正的影响。

sentences.en: Ben, I'm just struck by the fact that you said, you know, that he can't rewire the economy, right?
sentences.zh: 本，你刚才说他无法重塑经济，这一点让我印象深刻，对吧？

sentences.en: But at the same time, it appears like he is doing all of these really big things to put his stamp on it.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他似乎正在做所有这些非常重大的事情来打上他的烙印。

sentences.en: I do think this is Trump's economy now, right?
sentences.zh: 我确实认为现在这就是特朗普的经济了，对吧？

sentences.en: He spent the first several months of his term trying to blame things on Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 他任期的前几个月都在试图把事情归咎于乔·拜登。

sentences.en: You know, I won't take any view as to how voters will view this, but certainly he's been able to put in place the tariffs that he wanted to put in place.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不会对选民如何看待这一点发表任何看法，但可以肯定的是，他已经能够实施他想要实施的关税政策。

sentences.en: He's been able to get his tax bill through.
sentences.zh: 他已经能够通过他的税收法案。

sentences.en: You know, he blames some things on Jerome Powell, the Fed chair, but he's going to get his own Fed chair starting in May when he gets to appoint somebody.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他把一些事情归咎于美联储主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔，但他从五月份开始就能任命自己的美联储主席了。

sentences.en: So we are at a point where whatever happens in the economy, there's no one to blame or no one to take the credit if things work out other than him.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在处于这样一个阶段：无论经济发生什么，除了他自己，没有人可以责怪，也没有人可以居功。

sentences.en: This is his economy at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，这就是他的经济。

sentences.en: Thank you guys so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们来到这里。

sentences.en: We really appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢你们抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thanks, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In Texas, the authorities confirmed that at least 119 people had died in the recent flooding, and more than 170 remain missing,
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州，当局证实最近的洪灾中至少有 119 人死亡，仍有超过 170 人失踪，

sentences.en: raising the prospect that the death toll could climb much higher.
sentences.zh: 这增加了死亡人数可能进一步大幅上升的可能性。

sentences.en: Officials have struggled to answer questions about their response to the floods and whether a lack of warning sirens and insufficient disaster planning may have made the tragedy worse.
sentences.zh: 官员们在回答有关他们对洪灾的反应，以及缺乏警报器和灾难规划不足是否加剧了这场悲剧的问题时显得十分吃力。

sentences.en: When asked about investigating what went wrong, Texas Governor Greg Abbott said that those kinds of questions were the words of losers.
sentences.zh: 当被问及调查哪里出了问题时，德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特表示，这类问题是失败者的言论。

sentences.en: He compared disaster response to football, and said only losing teams focused on their failures.
sentences.zh: 他将灾难应对与橄榄球相提并论，并称只有失败的球队才会关注自己的失误。

sentences.en: And new data on Wednesday showed there have been more measles cases in the United States in 2025 than in any other year since the virus was declared eliminated in 2000.
sentences.zh: 周三公布的新数据显示，2025 年美国麻疹病例数超过了自 2000 年宣布消除该病毒以来的任何一年。

sentences.en: More than 1,288 people had a confirmed case of the measles this year.
sentences.zh: 今年有超过 1288 人确诊感染了麻疹。

sentences.en: Ninety-two percent of them were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination status.
sentences.zh: 其中 92% 的人未接种疫苗或疫苗接种状况不明。

sentences.en: Most of this year's cases were tied to an outbreak that began in January in a Mennonite community in West Texas, and then spread to New Mexico and Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 今年大部分病例与一月份在西德克萨斯州一个门诺派社区爆发的疫情有关，随后蔓延到了新墨西哥州和俄克拉荷马州。
